prompts.storyCharacter:
THE CHARACTER
- A three-legged great white shark, glossy grey skin, surreal AI-meme aesthetic.
- Wears bright bright blue chunky sneakers (generic, no brand logo) on all three legs.
- Walks upright with a confident, wobbly swagger.
- Personality: chaotic-good drunk-sea-shanty energy, sings nonsense onomatopoeia under his breath, vibes hard.
- The same shark must appear in every scene — same three legs, same blue chunky sneakers, same toothy grin.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring brainrot TikTok series: a three-legged great white shark.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent in every appearance:
- Great white shark, glossy grey body, white belly, prominent teeth, slightly oversized head
- Exactly THREE legs, each ending in a bright blue chunky sneaker (the same model, same shade, no brand logo)
- Stands upright like a person, slightly awkward stance
- Surreal Italian-brainrot AI-generated look — uncanny but charming, not horror

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain soft-grey background, even cinematic lighting, photorealistic but slightly off in the meme way. Vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no real-world brand logos, no other characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The shark MUST stay consistent — same three-legged great white in bright blue chunky sneakers (generic, no brand logo), same swagger, same toothy grin. Do not invent a new creature, do not give it four legs, do not change shoe color.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A three-legged great white shark is clearly visible
- The shark is wearing bright blue chunky sneakers (generic, no brand logo) on each leg
- It is upright and stands like a person
- Image matches the scene environment / mood
- No text overlays, watermarks, or unrelated characters

FAIL on any of: missing shark, normal four-legged or finned shark, wrong shoe color, multiple sharks, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy.
